items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Scriabin, Honegger, Scrivener, Hunager, Gustav Holtz (phonetic), the lot and we

ctx.x: Oh, yes, you know, in those days, we listened to music that had nothing to do with jazz as many of the great players had, black or white. We listened to people like Stravinsky, Jacque Ibert, Ravel, Debussy,
Scriabin, Honegger, Scrivener, Hunager, Gustav Holtz (phonetic), the lot and we

were introduced to this music by Bix, and played it all, who could play much of this music on the piano. You see, people don't know -- they think of Bix as being just a great cornet player, but he was a marvelous pianist.
